title: Synthesis and Characterization of Mannich-Derived 1,4-Naphthoquinones From Lawsone: Photophysical Properties, Molecular Docking, BSA/DNA Interactions, and Antioxidant Activity.
authors: Derin, Yavuz; Misir, Busra Albayrak; Gungor, Ozge; Gungor, Seyit Ali; Yilmaz, Rasit Fikret; Rohand, Taoufik; Tutar, Ahmet
one_liner_zh: 该文合成萘醌衍生物并评估其DNA/BSA结合及抗氧化活性，含分子对接但对象为小分子-DNA非特异性结合，非TF-DNA体系，方法深度有限。
abstract: The present study focuses on the synthesis of eight novel 2-hydroxy-1,4-naphthoquinone (lawsone) derivatives in moderate to high yields (31%-90%) via the Mannich reaction. The structures of the synthesized compounds (1-8) were characterized using a combination of analytical techniques, including HRMS, as well as (1)H and (13)C NMR spectroscopy. DNA and BSA binding interactions, along with the antioxidant activities of the newly synthesized 1,4-naphthoquinone derivatives, were systematically evaluated to assess the influence of various substituent groups on their biological performance. Among the tested compounds, compound 2, bearing a para-methyl substituent, exhibited the strongest DNA binding affinity with a binding constant of K(b) = 4.33 x 10(5) M(-) (1). Additionally, ethidium bromide (EB) displacement assays were performed, and corresponding K(sv) values were calculated to further elucidate the mode of DNA interaction. BSA binding studies also revealed distinct K(sv) values for each compound. Evaluation of antioxidant properties demonstrated that all derivatives exhibited concentration-dependent radical scavenging activity within the range of 6.25-200 microg/mL. Notably, compound 8 exhibited superior antioxidant performance, displaying approximately twice the activity of standard antioxidants. Molecular docking studies were performed on compounds exhibiting the highest biological activity in vitro, and their binding properties and interaction profiles to target proteins were investigated.
abstract_zh: 本研究聚焦于通过Mannich反应合成八种新型2-羟基-1,4-萘醌（lawsone）衍生物，产率中等至较高（31%-90%）。所合成化合物（1-8）的结构通过多种分析技术组合进行表征，包括HRMS以及(1)H和(13)C NMR光谱。对新合成的1,4-萘醌衍生物的DNA和BSA结合相互作用以及抗氧化活性进行了系统评估，以考察不同取代基对其生物性能的影响。在测试化合物中，带有对位甲基取代基的化合物2表现出最强的DNA结合亲和力，结合常数为K(b) = 4.33 x 10(5) M(-) (1)。此外，进行了溴化乙锭（EB）置换实验，并计算了相应的K(sv)值，以进一步阐明DNA相互作用模式。BSA结合研究也揭示了每种化合物具有不同的K(sv)值。抗氧化性能评估表明，所有衍生物在6.25-200微克/毫升范围内表现出浓度依赖性的自由基清除活性。值得注意的是，化合物8表现出优异的抗氧化性能，其活性约为标准抗氧化剂的两倍。对体外生物活性最高的化合物进行了分子对接研究，并探讨了它们与靶蛋白的结合性质和相互作用模式。
